name: Chef aux anneaux d’or
description: An old tall male chief with warm tan skin, small dark freckles, pointed cheek plates and a white streak running through long coarse dreadlocks. Wears an ochre layered ceremonial tunic under a narrow dark olive sleeveless robe, several large circular bronze necklaces and thin bone wrist cuffs. Carries a small closed octagonal clan reliquary in his left hand, right hand lightly touches its lid. No staff.
